question: Reviewing the CT angiography of a 70-year-old man under study for abdominal aortic aneurysm, the radiologist reports the presence of complete occlusion of the inferior mesenteric artery. enhanced_information: Complete occlusion of the inferior mesenteric artery can lead to asymptomatic presentation due to possible collateral circulation from nearby arteries. The middle colic artery is a likely source of collateral flow in this scenario.
analysis: Complete occlusion of the inferior mesenteric artery can lead to asymptomatic presentation due to collateral circulation from nearby arteries.
